info.name: Bazz — P2P FitTech (Merged)
info.description:
Complete, corrected Postman collection for the Bazz / P2P FitTech API.

ALL routes mount under /api/v1 (see src/routes/index.ts) and the dev server listens on PORT 4001 (src/config/index.ts).
So set:
  baseUrl = http://localhost:4001/api/v1
Every request path is RELATIVE to that (no extra /api/v1 in the path).

Tokens are captured automatically on login. Set the role tokens manually if you skip login:
  userToken / trainerToken / adminToken

Merged from the legacy 'Main' collection + the new modules (Commission, Promo Code, Withdrawal, Update, Subscription, Payment, Invoice). Fixed conflicts:
 - unified {{base_url}} / {{baseUrl}} → baseUrl (now includes /api/v1)
 - /trainers (plural) → /trainer (singular, real route)
 - category update/delete → PUT|DELETE /category/:id
 - content → /content/content (+ /content/categories)
 - invoice amount is in CENTS (2900 = $29.00)
